IS 1241 : 2024 Textiles - Handloom Cotton Calico, Bleached or Dyed - Specification
ICS 59.080.30
ICS 59.080.30
TXD 08
TXD 08
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes constructional particulars and other requirements of handloom cotton calico, bleached or dyed.
1.2 This standard does not specify the type of finish, general appearance, lustre and feel of cloth nor does it specify the degree of whiteness of bleached cloth or the colour of dyed cloth.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
